chunks: He said: "O son, do not narrate your dream to your brothers, or they will plot against you. Surely Satan is man's acknowledged foe."
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Jacob's advice to Joseph about his dream in Surah Yusuf?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Jacob (peace be upon him) advises his son Joseph (peace be upon him) to conceal his dream from his brothers to prevent their envy from escalating into active plotting. This guidance underscores the strategic prudence of the prophets and links the internal familial discord to the external influence of Satan, who is described as a 'clear enemy' seeking to mislead humanity through subtle means.
